subject: JQuery DataTable plugin - javascript binding issue?

messages.author: 55cb20da3fe82e18
messages.subject: JQuery DataTable plugin - javascript binding issue?
parts:
Similar to Laszlo's example of wrapping FooTables, I was interested in wrapping the DataTables plugin (http://datatables.net/blog/Twitter_Bootstrap_2) for outputting tables. DataTables has integration with Bootstrap that Shiny uses so the look is consistent (plus other important features like auto pagination, search, and supporting sorting of numbers with commas/decimals, etc)


I'm able to get it to work (pagination/search/sorting) if I manually specify the html in ui.R as such:


HTML(htmlTable(format(cbind(Province=rownames(swiss),swiss, Fer1K=swiss$Fertility * 1e3), big.mark=',', digits=2, scientific=FALSE)))


(htmlTable is just a wrapper function that adds <thead> to the header that xtable doesn't)


However, I can't get it to work by tying it to the server.R output i.e. tableOutput('view1')


It appears like the javascript binding doesn't occur - my guess is it has something to do with building outputs section of the tutorial (http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#building-outputs) but I can't find a complete example of what the renderValue function should be. Any suggestions?


I'm attaching a working example app.


Appreciate any help with the javascript.


Thanks


-Haider

FYI: I have a "solution" which involves appending javascript to the html that reactiveDataTable() returns i.e.

<script>$(function() {$('#example').dataTable(); });</script>

However, I'm not sure why that would be necessary because the initial javascripts that I load already has this code...

Any insights would be appreciated

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: JQuery DataTable plugin - javascript binding issue?
parts:
Using tags$head, I add:

      tags$script(src="js/DT_bootstrap.js",type="text/javascript"),

Within DT_bootstrap.js, the following function exists:

/* Table initialisation */
$(document).ready(function() {
$('#example').dataTable( {
"sDom": "<'row'<'span6'l><'span6'f>r>t<'row'<'span6'i><'span6'p>>",
"sPaginationType": "bootstrap",
"oLanguage": {
"sLengthMenu": "_MENU_ records per page"
}
} );
} );

which is a fancier version of:
<script>$(function() {$('#example').dataTable(); });</script>
Thanks
